Home / Sources

Every fact has a trail.

This project does not invent portal details. Below is the provenance of the register, the guide and the photographs used in the design.

Data

The LGU list, statuses, regions and check date are generated from the public better-lgu-directory register. The local snapshot was checked on Nov 19, 2026; refresh it with npm run data:sync.

Budget portal entries come from the register's BUDGET.md. Region names and codes follow the Philippine Standard Geographic Code list published in the same repository.

  • Better LGU Directory, live register
  • better-lgu-directory, source repository
  • Better LGU Guide, contributor instructions
  • BetterGov.ph, the wider initiative

Type & independence

The typefaces are the OFL-licensed families used by the reference Better Calatagan site, bundled locally in public/fonts. The historical map of the Philippines (1749) is by Pedro Murillo Velarde and is in the public domain; it is used as a historical illustration, not as a current boundary map.

Better Ibaan is an independent community project. It is not an official government website and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any local government unit or government agency.
